card.name: Dose steps in titration schedules
card.fires_on: The word dose (or the gap just before a number) in titration text, after stage words like initial, maintenance, target or previous. Also the empty spot before a mg amount in a step-by-step schedule.

modes.label: Dose after a stage word
modes.description: The word dose or dosing right after initial, maintenance, target, or previous.

modes.label: Space before a step amount
modes.description: The space just before a mg amount in a schedule of steps by day or week.
